title: The Palace Speaks
idiom: Piranesi-style etching, a library that answers
hero_prompt: Etching in the manner of Piranesi, black ink on warm paper, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible etched line texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: a vast vaulted library hall with towering shelves of books drawn as plain dark blocks with no lettering rising into arches, and at its far end a pair of great open doors glowing with warm light that spills out in soft rings like a voice; a lone visitor, a man in a long coat, stands at the threshold with one hand raised as if greeting someone inside.
icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a warm amber ground, no shading or gradients: a tall arched library doorway with three concentric arcs of sound radiating out of its opening. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
